interpretation.active_pipeline_support: May support execution of an already-declared canonical stage. Does not define a new scientific estimand.
interpretation.supporting_technical_audit: May test assumptions already declared by the canonical workflow. Must not create a new biological question or survivor rule.
interpretation.non_gating_exploratory: Retained for provenance and bounded exploration only. Cannot alter route admission, predictor choice, primary hypotheses or multiplicity.
interpretation.historical_execution_or_repair: Retained because it documents earlier execution, pilot or repair work. It is not an alternative active workflow and should not be extended unless needed to repair a concrete workflow failure.
interpretation.workflow_governance: Checks workflow registration and scope only; performs no scientific analysis.
